catalysts.headline: Presented first clinical data for lifileucel (TIL cell therapy) in previously treated soft-tissue sarcomas (undifferentiated pleomorphic sarcoma and dedifferentiated liposarcoma) in a Rapid Oral session (abstract #3725RO) at ESMO Congress 2026, Madrid, from an MSK-led, Iovance-supported pilot trial; registrational Phase 2 SARATOGA trial (NCT07741877) ongoing in the same indications. One Iovance release lists this session as Oct 23, 2026 instead -- date not fully reconciled, see conflicts.
catalysts.impact: Builds on Feb 2026 pilot data (50% confirmed ORR in first 6 evaluable patients); FDA fast track designation already granted for UPS/DDLPS

catalysts.headline: Presented final Phase 2 data (abstract 2072O, proffered paper) for lifileucel plus pembrolizumab in untreated advanced melanoma at ESMO Congress 2026, Madrid: median overall survival not reached at >4 years median follow-up (n=24), objective response rate 62.5%, complete response rate 29.2%. A separate press summary (ecancer) describes an overlapping but not identical analysis (n=27, median PFS 19.8 months, mOS not reached after 50.9 months follow-up) -- cohort definitions not reconciled. Phase 3 TILVANCE-301 (lifileucel+pembrolizumab vs. pembrolizumab alone) remains the registrational study for this frontline indication.
catalysts.impact: Positive durability/response data for the earlier-line melanoma combination, ahead of Phase 3 TILVANCE-301 results

catalysts.date: 2026-10-23 (per one Iovance release) / 2026-10-26 (per a second Iovance release and subsequent coverage)
catalysts.headline: Lifileucel sarcoma (UPS/DDLPS) pilot data at ESMO 2026: confirmed partial responses in 4 of 8 patients (50%) with refractory undifferentiated pleomorphic sarcoma or dedifferentiated liposarcoma who received in-specification product (as of a 2026-09-09 data cutoff); all 4 responses ongoing at cutoff. MSK-led pilot trial; registrational Phase 2 SARATOGA trial (NCT07741877) is the follow-on. Could not resolve the Oct 23 vs Oct 26 date discrepancy with a primary source — kept as unresolved conflict, not guessed.
catalysts.source: finviz.com (relaying Iovance's own releases); ajmc.com; targetedonc.com

catalysts.headline: Announced appointment of Noah Berkowitz, M.D., Ph.D. (former Arvinas CMO) as Chief Medical Officer, effective 2026-09-30; granted inducement stock options/RSUs covering up to 450,000 shares
catalysts.impact: Executive leadership change in clinical/medical strategy function

catalysts.headline: Iovance raised FY2026 total product revenue guidance to $410-420M (from $350-370M), a ~15% raise to the midpoint implying ~60% YoY total revenue growth, after Q2 2026 Amtagvi revenue ($90.7M) beat the company's own $79-81M quarterly forecast.

Raised FY2026 total revenue guidance to $410M-$420M (from $350M-$370M), implying ~60% full-year growth, citing strong US demand for Amtagvi and Proleukin; reiterated Q3/Q4 production visibility and a target of at least 110 treatment centers by year-end
catalysts.impact: Stock hit 2-year highs per one source

catalysts.headline: Raised FY2026 revenue guidance to $410M–$420M (as carried on file)

catalysts.headline: Iovance raises FY2026 total revenue guidance to $410-420M (from $350-370M) on strong Amtagvi and Proleukin commercial demand; shares surged
catalysts.impact: Stock up roughly 31.5% (one source) to 38.6% (another) intraday/close, continuing higher into 09-30; H.C. Wainwright raised its price target from $9 to $20

catalysts.headline: Q2 2026 results: record product revenue $99.3M (+66% YoY), adjusted loss per share $0.11 (beat estimate by $0.02), gross margin improved to 56% from 41% in Q1

Iovance reported Q2 2026 results: total revenue ~$99M (+66% YoY), with US Amtagvi revenue ~$91M beating guidance and consensus; gross margin 56%; cash and equivalents $304M at quarter-end; said it was reviewing its FY2026 revenue guidance of $350M–$370M with an update expected during Q3 2026
catalysts.impact: Large beat; stock reportedly had its best single day in over six years amid 'buyout buzz' commentary
